objective_convention: F = I(x) + gross_operational_cost - TV credit, EUR of total discounted planning cost (cost-breakdown schema v2; gross settlement-excluded)

per_screen_candidate.assumption: (1 + n_cand), n_cand = median |N| 39: 8 exit blocks + 1 settled batch; number of candidates not declared
per_screen_candidate.formula: T = kappa [psi t_exit sum(blocks) + t_set (confirmation batches)]

screen_L0.assumption: N_screen proper = 3 x 3 x 2 + L, L = 0; exit depth; blocks of 5
screen_L0.formula: T = kappa [psi t_exit sum(blocks) + t_set (confirmation batches)]

screen_L7.assumption: N_screen proper = 3 x 3 x 2 + L, L = 7; exit depth; blocks of 5
screen_L7.formula: T = kappa [psi t_exit sum(blocks) + t_set (confirmation batches)]

search_high_M6_complete.assumption: 6 moves, each improver at the last position (E_j = 39), 2 confirmations each; complete final poll 39 with 2 confirmations; no cache hits; |N| fixed at 39
search_high_M6_complete.formula: T = kappa [psi t_exit sum(blocks) + t_set (confirmation batches)]

search_low_M0.assumption: no accepted move; the start + one complete final poll (39); no cache hits; |N| fixed at 39
search_low_M0.formula: T = kappa [psi t_exit sum(blocks) + t_set (confirmation batches)]

search_mid_M3_first_block.assumption: 3 moves, each improver confirmed within the first block (E_j = 5), 1 confirmation each; complete final poll 39; no cache hits; |N| fixed at 39
search_mid_M3_first_block.formula: T = kappa [psi t_exit sum(blocks) + t_set (confirmation batches)]

projection.note: t_exit and t_set were measured inside concurrent blocks (5-way block 1, 2-way block 2), so they already carry contention; kappa = 1.18 multiplies it again (design formula as frozen); T_h_kappa_1 is the same count without kappa
